product.amstrad-anb-386sx40.summary: The 40 MB configuration with which Amstrad introduced its first notebook.
product.amstrad-anb-386sx40.history: Amstrad introduced the SX40 at CeBIT in March 1991 as its first notebook for the business market. Newsbytes reported an announced UK price of £1,999. In 1992, Amstrad advertised it in Spain at 279,900 pesetas plus VAT.
product.amstrad-anb-386sx40.technical.me: Advertised memory differed between the documented offers. In March 1991, Newsbytes reported 1 MB, expandable to 5 MB. Computerwoche described 2 MB in the German September offer.
product.amstrad-anb-386sx40.technical.vi: The built-in screen supported VGA graphics without an external monitor. Amstrad advertised a backlit LCD with 64 shades of grey and a colour VGA monitor output.
product.amstrad-anb-386sx40.technical.ve: The commercial configuration has been cross-checked against contemporary advertising and press. The BluMach sheet is in research.
product.amstrad-anb-386sx40.technical.li: An attributable BIOS dump, motherboard identification and boot validation in BluMach are pending.
